Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent made a critical error in Step 2 by misinterpreting the search results for "Otrag." While the search results clearly indicated that the entity "OTRAG" (Orbital Transport- und Raketen-Aktiengesellschaft) was a German company, the agent incorrectly concluded that the country was the "Democratic Republic of the Congo (formerly Zaire)." This conclusion contradicts the visible evidence in the search results (Wikipedia, Encyclopedia Astronautica, Rex Research) which all explicitly state OTRAG was a West German company based in Stuttgart or Neu-Isenburg. This error represents a failure to accurately extract and synthesize information from the provided web pages, leading to an incorrect geographical attribution that persisted in subsequent steps.
